summary: 主要な設計判断だけをADR/decision logとしてrepositoryに残し、AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.mdは短いmapとして『project固有のarchitecture決定』と参照先を示す（詳細はdocs/やSkillへ）。Agent間の設計原則の分岐と決定の消失を防ぐ。

evidence.summary: CLAUDE.mdに含めるもの: 「Architectural decisions specific to your project」「Common gotchas or non-obvious behaviors」; 除外: codeから読める事、長い説明。「Would removing this cause Claude to make mistakes?」で剪定。
OpenAI: 約100行のAGENTS.mdを目次にし、docs/（design-docs, product-specs, exec-plans, references）に知識を置く。単一組織事例。
ADR: 一決定一記録、根拠・trade-off・結果を記録し、集合がdecision logになる。MADR template・toolingあり。AI以前からの確立実務。
短い常時mapとtask時詳細読込はoperationally-supported。ownership-metadata（reason/owner/version）はcandidate。

domain-modeling (public, reputation established): pass 1 read skills/domain-modeling/SKILL.md in TechLog: 'Offer ADRs sparingly' gates ADRs behind three tests (hard to reverse, surprising without context, the result of a real trade-off) and the file-structure section places them under docs/adr/ with a root map file.

applies_when: 複数Agent/人が同じrepositoryで設計判断を行う
chatで合意した決定が後続sessionに伝わらない
仕様やarchitectureの変更が発生した
not_applicable_when: 決定を保守するownerが不在

expected_effect.primary: 設計原則の単一正本化により、Agentごとの原則分岐と決定の再議論を減らす
metrics: 同一論点の再決定・再質問回数
docs/と実装の不一致指摘数

risks: ADRが肥大化して読まれない
決定と実装のlinkが無いと文書drift（B07）を再生産
cost: ADR template導入と初期数件の記録に数時間、以後1決定10〜20分
known_failure_modes: 全議論をchat logのまま保存する（決定だけを残さないとnoise）
巨大なAGENTS.mdに設計原則を全て書く（context希釈で無視される）
revalidate_when: Agentのdocs参照挙動が変わるharness更新
ADR件数が増え検索性が落ちた時

existing_asset.confirmed_by: pass 1 read skills/domain-modeling/SKILL.md in TechLog: 'Offer ADRs sparingly' gates ADRs behind three tests (hard to reverse, surprising without context, the result of a real trade-off) and the file-structure section places them under docs/adr/ with a root map file.
matched_on: record an architectural decision as an ADR under docs/adr/ in the repository
offer ADRs sparingly - only hard to reverse, surprising without context, and the result of a real trade-off
a root CONTEXT.md / CONTEXT-MAP.md that points to where each context and its decisions live
existing_asset.verified_by: existing-skill research 2026-08-15 (ai-development-improvement 0.7.1 lookup + reputation pass, Opus workers)

alternates.why_not_primary: Dedicated Nygard-format ADR skill with wider install count (572) but a 536-star repo with no independent standing, and it says nothing about keeping the always-loaded instruction file a short map.

evidence: https://github.com/product-on-purpose/pm-skills (536 stars, 71 forks, last commit 2026-08-15; 572 installs per pass 1)

alternates.why_not_primary: Same established repo, but it is a thin wrapper that produces ADRs only as a side effect of a grilling session.

evidence: listed at skills/engineering/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md in the repo tree at HEAD

alternates.why_not_primary: Covers the other half (auditing AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md down to a short map) but records no design decisions; org-private.
